# constraints.yaml — Machine-readable engineering constraints
# THIS FILE IS THE CANONICAL SOURCE for all regex patterns and numeric thresholds. Enforcement scripts read from here at runtime; do not hardcode duplicates.
# Generated by eng-init. Single source of truth for all thresholds, regex patterns,
# and enforcement rules. CI scripts, pre-commit hooks, and lint configs should
# reference this file rather than hardcoding values.

# ── Strictness Profile ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Chosen by the user at grilling Q1.4. All thresholds below were resolved from
# this profile's column in the question-bank Strictness Profile table.
# Levels: L1 prototype | L2 standard | L3 strict | L4 maximal.
# Enforcement vocabulary: advice < review-only < warn < block < gate.

strictness_profile:
  schema_version: "{{SCHEMA_VERSION}}"  # resolved from SKILL.md version at render time
  level: "{{PROFILE_LEVEL}}"          # L1 | L2 | L3 | L4
  chosen_by_user: true                # must be true — eng-init never defaults this
  downgrades:                         # every deviation below the profile default, with reason
    {{DOWNGRADES_LIST_OR_EMPTY}}      # e.g. - control: e2e_tests
                                      #        profile_default: required
                                      #        chosen: deferred
                                      #        reason: "no UI yet — re-ask at first UI PR"

# ── Generated Section Registry ─────────────────────────────────
# Repair mode uses this registry to update only sections eng-init owns while
# preserving hand-written project rules. Do not use inline HTML markers in
# AGENTS.md unless the user asks for them.

generated_sections:
  agents_md:
    - title: "Code Canonicality"
      owner: "eng-init"
      template_version: "{{SCHEMA_VERSION}}"
    - title: "Project Identity"
      owner: "eng-init"
      template_version: "{{SCHEMA_VERSION}}"
    - title: "Stack & Versions"
      owner: "eng-init"
      template_version: "{{SCHEMA_VERSION}}"
    - title: "Directory Map"
      owner: "eng-init"
      template_version: "{{SCHEMA_VERSION}}"
    - title: "Development Workflow"
      owner: "eng-init"
      template_version: "{{SCHEMA_VERSION}}"
    - title: "Verification Matrix"
      owner: "eng-init"
      template_version: "{{SCHEMA_VERSION}}"
    {{IF_RUNTIME_LIFECYCLE}}
    - title: "Runtime Lifecycle"
      owner: "eng-init"
      template_version: "{{SCHEMA_VERSION}}"
    {{END_IF}}
    {{IF_REFACTOR_CONTRACT}}
    - title: "Source of Truth & Refactor Contract"
      owner: "eng-init"
      template_version: "{{SCHEMA_VERSION}}"
    {{END_IF}}
    - title: "Important Development Notes"
      owner: "eng-init"
      template_version: "{{SCHEMA_VERSION}}"
    - title: "Conventions"
      owner: "eng-init"
      template_version: "{{SCHEMA_VERSION}}"
    - title: "Code Review Self-Check"
      owner: "eng-init"
      template_version: "{{SCHEMA_VERSION}}"
    {{IF_ARCHITECTURE_DISCIPLINE}}
    - title: "Architecture Discipline"
      owner: "eng-init"
      template_version: "{{SCHEMA_VERSION}}"
    {{END_IF}}
    - title: "Critical Paths"
      owner: "eng-init"
      template_version: "{{SCHEMA_VERSION}}"
    {{IF_OBSERVABILITY}}
    - title: "Observability"
      owner: "eng-init"
      template_version: "{{SCHEMA_VERSION}}"
    {{END_IF}}
    - title: "Agent Operating Rules"
      owner: "eng-init"
      template_version: "{{SCHEMA_VERSION}}"
    - title: "Enforcement Index"
      owner: "eng-init"
      template_version: "{{SCHEMA_VERSION}}"
  preserve_unknown_sections: true
  backup_policy: ".eng-init/backups/<UTC>/ only when explicitly requested"


# ── Code Canonicality ──────────────────────────────────────────

code_canonicality:
  forbidden_suffixes:
    description: "Filenames/identifiers matching these patterns are rejected at commit"
    patterns:
      - "{{FORBIDDEN_SUFFIX_REGEX}}"
      - "{{FORBIDDEN_PASCALCASE_REGEX}}"
    enforced_by: ".git-hooks/check-naming.sh"
  scratchpad_directories:
    description: "Directories that must never appear in commits"
    paths: {{SCRATCHPAD_DIRS_LIST}}
    enforced_by: ".git-hooks/check-naming.sh + .gitignore"

# ── Size Limits ────────────────────────────────────────────────

size_limits:
  max_file_lines:
    value: {{MAX_FILE_LINES}}          # from profile: L1=1000 L2=900 L3=800 L4=700
    severity: "{{SIZE_SEVERITY}}"      # L1=warn, L2+=block
    enforced_by: "lint config ({{LINT_FILE_SIZE_RULE}})"
  max_complexity:
    value: {{MAX_COMPLEXITY}}          # from profile: L1=30 L2=20 L3=15 L4=10
    severity: "{{SIZE_SEVERITY}}"      # L1=warn, L2+=block
    enforced_by: "lint config ({{LINT_COMPLEXITY_RULE}})"
  max_function_lines:
    value: {{MAX_FUNCTION_LINES}}          # stack-specific default, not profile-keyed (e.g., Go=80, TS=200, Py=100, Rust=150, Java=200)
    severity: "{{SIZE_SEVERITY}}"
    enforced_by: "lint config ({{LINT_FUNC_SIZE_RULE}})"
  max_pr_diff_lines:
    value: 400
    description: "PRs exceeding this require justification or splitting"
    # Be honest about the level: review-only is a checklist item, not a check.
    severity: "{{PR_DIFF_SEVERITY}}"   # L1=none, L2=review-only, L3-L4=block
    enforced_by: "{{PR_DIFF_ENFORCEMENT}}"  # L2: PR template checklist (review-only); L3-L4: CI diff-size guard step

# ── Test Discipline ────────────────────────────────────────────

testing:
  min_line_coverage:
    value: {{COVERAGE_PERCENT}}        # from profile: L1=none L2=70 L3=80 L4=90
    scope: "{{COVERAGE_SCOPE}}"        # per-file (L3/L4 default) | global — mirrors the AGENTS.md Coverage threshold rule
    severity: "block"                  # CI fails below threshold at L2+; omit gate entirely at L1
    enforced_by: "CI coverage gate ({{COVERAGE_CONFIG_PATH}})"
  tdd_mode:
    value: "{{TDD_MODE}}"  # none | preferred | required
    description: "If required, every new production file must have a paired test file"
  forbid_mock_of_system_under_test:
    value: true
    description: "Mock dependencies, never the system under test"

# ── Dependency Rules ───────────────────────────────────────────

dependencies:
  min_release_age_days:
    value: {{MIN_RELEASE_AGE}}
    enforced_by: "Renovate / Dependabot config"
  no_circular_dependencies:
    value: true
    enforced_by: "lint ({{CIRCULAR_DEP_TOOL}})"
  new_dependency_requires_justification:
    value: true
    description: "PR description must explain why existing tools can't do the job"
  allowed_licenses:
    value: {{ALLOWED_LICENSES_LIST}}
    enforced_by: "CI license audit"

# ── Anti-Drift ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

anti_drift:
  duplicate_code_threshold_percent:
    value: {{DUPLICATE_THRESHOLD}}     # from profile: L1=10 L2=5 L3=3 L4=2; exact only for percent-capable detectors such as jscpd
    severity: "{{ANTI_DRIFT_SEVERITY}}"  # L1=warn, L2+=block
    enforced_by: "jscpd directly; pylint-duplicate / dupl / PMD CPD are stack-specific mappings"
  dead_code_min_confidence:
    value: 80
    severity: "{{ANTI_DRIFT_SEVERITY}}"  # L1=warn, L2+=block
    enforced_by: "vulture / knip / golangci-lint unused"

# ── Module Boundaries ──────────────────────────────────────────

module_boundaries:
  layers: {{LAYERS_LIST}}
  allowed_dependency_directions: {{DEPENDENCY_DIRECTIONS}}
  forbidden_import_patterns: {{FORBIDDEN_IMPORT_PATTERNS}}
  enforced_by: "{{BOUNDARY_TOOL}} ({{BOUNDARY_CONFIG_PATH}})"

# ── Commit Discipline ──────────────────────────────────────────

commits:
  conventional_commits_required:
    value: true
    allowed_types: ["feat", "fix", "refactor", "chore", "docs", "test", "ci", "build", "perf"]
    enforced_by: "commitlint / commitizen / .git-hooks/commit-msg"
    agent_co_author_required: true

# ── CI Pipeline ────────────────────────────────────────────────

ci:
  risk_layers: 5
  fast_checks_timeout_minutes: 5
  matrix: {{CI_MATRIX}}

# ── Runtime Verification ───────────────────────────────────────
# Machine-readable mirror of the AGENTS.md Verification Matrix — harnesses
# execute from here, humans read AGENTS.md. Keep the two in sync; the Stage 4
# check verifies every command below resolves to the selected dev entry point
# (`justfile`, `Makefile`, or `package.json` script).

verification:
  {{IF_LONG_RUNNING_PROCESS}}
  health_url: "{{HEALTH_URL_OR_EMPTY}}"   # empty when Q7.1 falls back to process liveness
  dev_port: {{DEV_PORT_OR_NULL}}
  {{END_IF}}
  surfaces:
    {{IF_LONG_RUNNING_PROCESS}}
    liveness:
      command: "{{DEV_STATUS_CMD}}"        # e.g. just dev-status | make dev-status | npm run dev:status
      evidence: "process-live{{IF_HEALTH_ENDPOINT}}+health-ok{{END_IF}}"
      required_at: "L2+"
    {{END_IF}}
    {{IF_API_VERIFICATION}}
    api:
      command: "{{SMOKE_CMD}}"            # e.g. just smoke | make smoke | npm run smoke
      evidence: "http-status+body"
      required_at: "L2+"                # recommended at L2, gate at L3+
    {{END_IF}}
    {{IF_UI_VERIFICATION}}
    ui:
      command: "{{VERIFY_UI_CMD}}"        # e.g. just verify-ui | make verify-ui | npm run verify-ui
      evidence: "screenshot+console-clean"
      required_at: "L3+"                # only when a UI exists
    {{END_IF}}
    {{IF_CLI_VERIFICATION}}
    cli:
      command: "{{CLI_VERIFY_CMD}}"       # run the binary against fixture input
      evidence: "exit-code+stdout"
      required_at: "L2+"
    {{END_IF}}
    {{IF_DB_VERIFICATION}}
    migration:
      command: "{{DB_VERIFY_CMD}}"        # e.g. just db-verify | make db-verify | npm run db:verify
      evidence: "up-down-up-clean"      # against a seeded local database
      required_at: "L2+"
    {{END_IF}}
    {{IF_JOB_VERIFICATION}}
    job:
      command: "{{JOB_VERIFY_CMD}}"       # trigger once, assert the observable side effect
      evidence: "log-line+side-effect"
      required_at: "L3+"
    {{END_IF}}
  # Delete every surface whose command cannot be resolved through the selected dev entry point; a machine-readable row without a target is phantom verification.
  enforced_by: "Stage 4 matrix-to-target check over constraints.yaml + AGENTS.md Verification Matrix + PR Runtime evidence section"

# ── Exemptions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Per-path opt-outs from specific checks with mandatory justification.
# Exemptions are permanent exceptions (generated code, vendored libs,
# intentionally large files) — distinct from baseline freezes which
# are temporary ceilings. Stage 0 scan flags candidate paths
# (generated/, vendor/, *.pb.go, *.gen.ts); user confirms at Q5.2b.

exemptions:
  entries:
    # Example:
    # - path: "src/gen/proto.pb.go"
    #   rules: [size_limits]           # exempt from file-size checks only
    #   reason: "Generated protobuf code — not human-authored"
    #   expires: never                 # never | YYYY-MM-DD
    #   exit_condition: "generator emits split files"  # what would make this exemption removable; "none" only for structural exemptions (vendored/generated)
    # NOTE: empty render must produce `entries: []`, not a bare key.
    {{EXEMPTIONS_LIST_OR_EMPTY}}      # Populated during Stage 2 grilling; sequence of {path, rules, reason, expires, exit_condition}
  enforced_by: "lint/CI scripts skip exempted paths (reference this section)"

# ── Violation Baseline ─────────────────────────────────────────
# pre-existing violations against the chosen profile's gates (Q1.4b).
# TEMPORARY: remove this whole block, the AGENTS.md baseline section, and the
# CI baseline-comparison step when every count reaches 0.

baseline:
  mode: "{{BASELINE_MODE}}"             # none | freeze | fix-now
  rev: "{{BASELINE_REV}}"               # commit at which the counts were recorded
  counts:                               # recorded ceilings, not targets
    duplicate_code: {{BASELINE_DUPLICATE_CODE}}   # CI ratchet step compares this key; do not rename
    dead_code: {{BASELINE_DEAD_CODE}}             # advisory record — no CI comparison step yet; do not present as enforced
    size_violations: {{BASELINE_SIZE_VIOLATIONS}} # advisory record — no CI comparison step yet; do not present as enforced
    coverage_gap: {{BASELINE_COVERAGE_GAP}}       # advisory record — no CI comparison step yet; do not present as enforced
  # Ratchet rule: counts may only decrease. CI compares current counts against
  # these ceilings and fails on any increase. Raising a ceiling is a profile
  # downgrade — follow the downgrade procedure (explicit user confirmation +
  # entry in strictness_profile.downgrades).
  enforced_by: "CI baseline-comparison step"

# ── Rehabilitation State ───────────────────────────────────────
# Optional. Render when Stage 0 detected a degraded engineering surface and
# eng-init must stabilize the harness before broad refactors.

rehabilitation:
  active: {{REHABILITATION_ACTIVE}}       # true only for degraded-project overlay
  phase: "{{REHABILITATION_PHASE}}"       # none | stabilize-harness | split-work-units | broad-refactor-ready
  baseline_frozen: {{BASELINE_FROZEN}}    # true once baseline.mode == freeze and counts are recorded
  command_entrypoint: "{{COMMAND_ENTRYPOINT}}"  # e.g., just check | make check | npm run check; empty string when missing
  runtime_verifier: "{{RUNTIME_VERIFIER}}"      # e.g., just smoke | make smoke | npm run smoke | just compare | make compare | npm run compare; empty string when missing
  broad_refactor_allowed: {{BROAD_REFACTOR_ALLOWED}} # false until baseline_frozen and runtime_verifier are true
  work_unit_protocol: "{{WORK_UNIT_PROTOCOL}}"  # none | agent_tasks | issue-tracker | github-labels
  readiness_gaps: {{REHABILITATION_GAPS_LIST_OR_EMPTY}}
  enforced_by: "AGENTS.md Rehabilitation gate + Verification Matrix + constraints.yaml baseline"


# ── Refactor Contract ──────────────────────────────────────────
# Optional. Render only when the large-refactor overlay is active (question-bank
# Dimension 9). This is the machine-readable mirror of AGENTS.md
# `## Source of Truth & Refactor Contract`.

refactor_contract:
  active: {{REFACTOR_ACTIVE}}            # true only when Dimension 9 overlay is active; otherwise false
  kind: "{{REFACTOR_KIND}}"              # port | rewrite | framework-migration | compatibility-refactor | none
  source_of_truth:
    # Empty render when inactive: []
    # Example:
    # - surface: behavior
    #   reference: "legacy/"
    #   verification: "just compare"
    # - surface: compiler-ir
    #   reference: "fixtures/ir/"
    #   verification: "just compare-ir"
    {{REFACTOR_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH_LIST_OR_EMPTY}}
  compare_depth: "{{COMPARE_DEPTH}}"     # final-output | diagnostics | intermediate-state | real-project-conformance | none
  cutover_policy: "{{CUTOVER_POLICY}}"   # clean-cutover | staged-dual-run | compatibility-bridge | human-approved-exception | none
  forbidden_moves:
    # Defaults when active:
    # - weaken-compare-tests
    # - shell-out-to-legacy
    # - silent-fallback-to-old-code
    # - unapproved-dual-production-path
    # - final-output-only-when-intermediate-oracle-exists
    {{REFACTOR_FORBIDDEN_MOVES_OR_EMPTY}}
  work_ownership: "{{WORK_OWNERSHIP_PROTOCOL}}"  # agent_tasks | issue-tracker | github-labels | external-tracker | single-owner | none
  human_gates: {{REFACTOR_HUMAN_GATES_LIST_OR_EMPTY}}
  enforced_by: "AGENTS.md Source of Truth section + Verification Matrix compare rows + task ownership protocol"

# ── Iteration Gates ────────────────────────────────────────────
# Be honest about the level: these are review-only unless a harness consumes them.

iteration_gates:
  max_fix_cycles: 3                     # per failing check, then stop and report
  checkpoint_commit_at_green: true
  test_weakening_forbidden: true        # skip requires linked issue + deadline
  one_task_one_branch: true
  enforced_by: "AGENTS.md Agent Operating Rules (review-only) + harness loop config where present"

# ── Environments ───────────────────────────────────────────────

environments:
  local: "full"                         # read + write + execute
  staging: "deploy-via-ci, read-logs"
  prod: "{{PROD_ACCESS_OR_NONE}}"       # e.g. none | read-logs
  enforced_by: "credential scoping + AGENTS.md Environment tiers"
